components.currentBehavior: Validates template, creates activity record, executes tasks, saves to local storage only
components.desiredBehavior: Should also capture initial state (git commit, branch, modified files, impulse IDs) and POST activity content to backend API after creation
components.gap: Missing call to storeActivityContent() after Activity.create() around line 539. No HTTP client exists to make this call.

components.currentBehavior: Creates activity record with id, status, executionEvidence, workArtifacts, stats. Saves to local storage.
components.desiredBehavior: Should include initial_state capture with git_commit, git_branch, working_directory, modified_files before execution begins
components.gap: No state capture functions implemented. captureInitialState() does not exist.

components.currentBehavior: Enhances reason with last 5 messages from parent session to provide context for memory agent
components.desiredBehavior: Should preserve this enhancement and include it in activity content POST to backend API
components.gap: Works correctly for local context but enhanced reason not persisted to backend for learning loop

components.currentBehavior: Executes tasks sequentially, tracks impulse deltas, accumulates variables for task chaining, reports execution steps to MCP non-blocking
components.desiredBehavior: Should also capture state before/after each task (git diff, files changed, validation results) and POST to backend API
components.gap: Missing recordTaskStart() call before task execution (around line 1890) and updateTaskExecution() after completion (around line 2430). No state capture at task boundaries.

components.desiredBehavior: Should include state_delta computation (files created/modified/deleted, git diff) and validation results in task update payload
components.gap: No computeDelta() function. No state capture before/after task execution.

components.gap: Entire HTTP client implementation missing. This is the critical blocker - backend API exists but frontend never calls it.

components.desiredBehavior: captureInitialState() capturing git branch/commit/dirty status, modified files, impulse IDs, working directory. captureCurrentState() for task-level snapshots. computeDelta() for state transformations (files added/modified/deleted, git diff, impulses created).
components.gap: All state capture logic missing. Cannot track instructional → functional state transformation.

components.gap: Snapshot utilities exist and work correctly but not integrated with activity tracking instrumentation

phases.name: Phase 1: State Capture Functions
tasks: Create activity-state-capture.ts module
Implement captureInitialState() - git branch/commit/dirty, modified files, impulse IDs, working directory
Implement captureCurrentState() - same as initial but called at different times
Implement computeDelta() - files added/modified/deleted, lines changed, git diff, impulses created
Integrate Snapshot.track() and Snapshot.diff() for git state

phases.name: Phase 2: HTTP Client
tasks: Create activity-client.ts with ActivityAPIClient class
Implement storeActivityContent() - POST /v2/activities/content
Implement recordTaskStart() - POST /v2/activities/tasks
Implement updateTaskExecution() - PATCH /v2/activities/tasks/:id
Add retry logic with exponential backoff (3 attempts, base delay 1s)
Add non-blocking error handling (log warnings, don't fail execution)

phases.name: Phase 3: Instrumentation Points
tasks: Add storeActivityContent() call after Activity.create() (activity.ts line 539)
Add recordTaskStart() call before task execution (activity.ts line 1890)
Add updateTaskExecution() call after task completion (activity.ts line 2430)
Integrate state capture at each instrumentation point
Ensure non-blocking behavior (execution continues if backend unavailable)

phases.name: Phase 4: Bug Fixes
tasks: Fix race condition: Save activity after each task (line 2430) not just at end
Replace 38 instances of .catch(() => {}) with .catch(error => log.warn('non-blocking error', { error }))
Add variable type validation in ActivityTemplate.validateVariables() (check string/number/array types)

phases.name: Phase 5: Testing
tasks: Unit tests for state capture functions (captureInitialState, computeDelta)
Integration tests for HTTP client (mock backend, test retry logic)
End-to-end test: Create activity → Execute → Verify backend has complete data
Verify replay works with captured state (can restart from known initial_state)
Verify non-blocking behavior (backend down doesn't break execution)

successCriteria: Every activity execution stores complete context in SurrealDB via backend API
Every task execution tracked with state before/after (git diffs, files changed)
Initial state captured with git_commit, git_branch, working_directory, modified_files
Reason field populated with enhanced context from parent session
Task_sequence array populated with all task definitions and results
Template_definition included with complete task definitions
Variable_bindings captured with actual values provided
Execution succeeds even if backend unavailable (non-blocking)
Race condition fixed (incremental saves prevent data loss)
